title: driver: defer packages with Modaliases
description:
Detect driver-related upgrades

This change teaches `unattended-upgrades` to detect packages whose APT metadata contains `Modaliases`, identifying transactions that may affect hardware drivers.

When an eligible upgrade transaction contains a package with Modaliases, the existing safety checks reject it for ordinary unattended installation. The transaction is therefore left for the later driver-deferral and shutdown-handling phases.

The change preserves the existing package-selection and origin checks and adds focused coverage for Modaliases detection, transaction rejection, and the relevant APT metadata.

This phase only adds detection and safety filtering. Scheduling deferred work and installing it during shutdown are handled in later phases.

+#!/usr/bin/python3
+
+import os
+import unittest
+
+import unattended_upgrade
+from test.test_base import MockOptions, TestBase
+
+
+class TestDriverDeferral(TestBase):
+
+    def setUp(self):
+        TestBase.setUp(self)
+        self.mock_allowed_origins(
+            "origin=Ubuntu,archive=lucid-security")
+        rootdir = self.make_fake_aptroot(
+            os.path.join(self.testdir, "root.driver-deferral"))
+        self.cache = unattended_upgrade.UnattendedUpgradesCache(
+            rootdir=rootdir)
+
+    def test_modaliases_dependency_defers_entire_root_transaction(self):
+        root = self.cache["ordinary-root"]
+        root.mark_upgrade(from_user=True)
+
+        self.assertEqual(
+            {pkg.name for pkg in self.cache.get_changes()},
+            {"ordinary-root", "driver-dependency"})
+        self.assertEqual(
+            unattended_upgrade.sanity_problem(self.cache, root),
+            "pkg driver-dependency has Modaliases and is not safe to "
+            "upgrade unattended")
+        self.assertFalse(
+            unattended_upgrade.check_changes_for_sanity(self.cache, root))
+
+        self.cache.clear()
+        to_upgrade = unattended_upgrade.calculate_upgradable_pkgs(
+            self.cache, MockOptions())
+
+        self.assertEqual(
+            [pkg.name for pkg in to_upgrade], ["unrelated-safe"])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
